title: Understanding ROC Curves
text: A ROC curve plots the true positive rate (TPR) against the false positive rate (FPR) at various threshold settings. The curve helps to visualize the performance of a binary classifier.

title: Thresholds in ROC Curves
text: The thresholds are used to determine the point at which a predicted probability is considered a positive prediction. These thresholds are typically varied from $$0$$ to $$1$$ to generate the ROC curve.
